text:
ashwin: Heads-up — proposing a small SDK/HTTP header contract to control routing hints and variant probes. We need something lightweight for customers + debug flags for our rollout UX. Thoughts?

maria-devex: +1 on something small. want to avoid leaking tier info to public clients. maybe use token-scoped routing metadata?

kevin: agree. Suggest headers:
```
X-RW-Region: eu-west-1
X-RW-Tier: premium
X-RW-Debug: route_probe=1;force_variant=latency_opt
```
Pros: simple. Cons: clients can override tier header; must be validated server-side.

elaine: validation is mandatory — we should map X-RW-Tier to entitlements in the auth token server-side. Also we need a 'probe' that doesn't consume quota (or consume soft quota).

ashwin: good call. proposal: header is advisory only. server checks entitlement and then adds route_decision.reason in telemetry. Also probe requests should be rate-limited and flagged by metric label `routing.probe=true`.

sam-sre: for SLOs we need fallback semantics: if preferred variant unavailable, fallback order should be (pinned) -> same-arch quantized -> latency-optimized -> gpu-fallback. We should emit `routing.fallback_reason` in traces.

maria-devex: UX ask — Console should show per-customer "Routing overrides" panel showing last 3 probes, last fallback reason, and effective variant. Also surface SDK-sent headers in request detail.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary rollout plan added to infra: route-probe flag enabled in staging, will run 1000 probe requests/hour.

kevin: edge case: what about cross-region preference? header `X-RW-Region-Pref` can be list `eu,us`; we'll do best-effort but enforce entitlements and capacity.

elaine: test plan: add unit tests for header parsing; e2e for probe counting and telemetry labels; update console docs + telemetry query snippets.

ashwin: great. I'll write an RFC draft and include the header parsing sample and telemetry labels. tagging @maria-devex @kevin for review. :thumbsup:
